meta.title: Agent plans & pricing — Starter, Pro, Premium, Signature, Team
meta.description: CloseBoss plans for real estate agents: Starter (free), Pro ($79/mo, Producer Track coaching), Premium ($199/mo, Top Producer Track), Signature ($399/mo, bilingual + luxury concierge), and Team ($299/mo, brokerage workflows). Annual billing saves 2 months. 14-day trial on every paid tier.
